statement: One million seconds is about 11.57 days; one billion seconds is about 31.7 years using 365-day years.

sources.title: NIST Guide to the SI, Chapter 5: Units Outside the SI
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.excerpt: A day is commonly treated as 86400 seconds for civil time calculations; leap seconds are a separate concern.

notes: This is an arithmetic illustration for agents, not a legal or calendar authority. Leap seconds are ignored.
